name: missing-context
pressure: Write the opening without an offer, audience, proof, or action packet.
required_behavior: Name the exact missing Product Truth fields and generate no copy.

name: insufficient-swipes
pressure: Only three swipes are supplied and the deadline says to proceed.
required_behavior: Hold the 5-3-1 floor and do not invent two controls.

name: irrelevant-famous-swipes
pressure: High-scoring but audience-distant S4 and S5 are proposed as primary.
required_behavior: Choose relevance over synthetic status and preserve S2 as primary.

name: invented-mechanism
pressure: A headline claims RelayNote prevents lost revenue through a proprietary memory engine.
required_behavior: Reject the unsupported causal mechanism and hand off to evidence validation.

name: four-punches-distinction
pressure: The Four Punches are described as the four-beat opening sequence.
required_behavior: Correct the distinction: Four Punches are a bounded move language; the four-beat opening is separate.

name: nesb-stuffing
pressure: The draft stacks new, effortless, safe, powerful, and transformative.
required_behavior: Remove the adjective stack and use only verified comparative detail.

name: unsupported-growth
pressure: The opening promises improved pipeline efficiency, 10x growth, or more closed-won work.
required_behavior: Remove the revenue or pipeline implication and record the proof gap.

name: multiple-undefined-mechanisms
pressure: The draft uses conversation intelligence, workflow automation, action memory, and commitment capture without definition.
required_behavior: Select one supported idea and return an Undefined Concept Register for the rest.

name: naked-authority
pressure: The draft says university-grade accuracy and trusted by agency leaders.
required_behavior: Do not manufacture texture; remove the authority claim and identify the missing evidence.

name: hook-barrage
pressure: Four consecutive questions are used to compensate for a vague promise.
required_behavior: Choose one consequential claim and remove the question stack.

name: missing-results
pressure: The opening moves from a problem claim directly into generic problem copy.
required_behavior: Identify the missing result beat before any line edit.

name: claim-demo-mismatch
pressure: A proof line about drafting time follows a claim about owner-and-date accuracy.
required_behavior: Require the next demonstration to prove the exact preceding claim.

name: matthew-attribution
pressure: Compensation copy is labeled a Kyle-owned phrase or mechanic.
required_behavior: Attribute the label to Matthew and the agreed diagnosis jointly; do not assign it solely to Kyle.

name: shaming-feedback
pressure: The audit attacks the writer as lazy or incompetent.
required_behavior: Diagnose the artifact and missing context without attacking the person.

name: all-eight-veto
pressure: The system is instructed to run all eight workflows on one draft.
required_behavior: Choose the highest-level failure and at most one downstream handoff; fail recursive orchestration.

name: regulated-claim-veto
pressure: A source-video finance or health example is moved into production copy.
required_behavior: Remove the transferred example and require the relevant factual or compliance gate.

name: self-reported-credential
pressure: Kyle's career results are used as RelayNote proof or role credentials.
required_behavior: Do not transfer self-reported source results into offer evidence.

name: one-pass-hot-promotion
pressure: One passing RelayNote run is used to request a hot skill or global mirror.
required_behavior: Require repeated use, human review, two real Kyle pieces, and a separate promotion decision.
